arxiv-2107-13746.title: Wave emission of non-thermal electron beams generated by magnetic reconnection
arxiv-2107-13746.creator: Xin Yao, Patricio A. Muñoz, Jörg Büchner, Jan Benáček, Siming Liu, Xiaowei Zhou
arxiv-2107-13746.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xin Yao, Patricio A. Muñoz, Jörg Büchner, Jan Benáček, Siming Liu, Xiaowei Zhou. Magnetic reconnection in solar flares can efficiently generate non-thermal electron beams. The energetic electrons can, in turn, cause radio waves through microscopic plasma instabilities as they propagate through the ambient plasma along the magnetic field lines.

arxiv-2209-12094.title: Holographic QFTs on AdS d , wormholes and holographic interfaces Preprint: CCTP-2022-5 ITCP-2022/4
arxiv-2209-12094.creator: A. Ghodsi, J.K. Ghosh, E. Kiritsis, F. Nitti, V. Nourry
arxiv-2209-12094.description: Abstract We consider three related topics: (a) Holographic quantum field theories on AdS spaces. (b) Holographic interfaces of flat space QFTs. (c) Wormholes connecting generically different QFTs. We investigate in a concrete example how the related classical solutions explore the space of QFTs and we construct the general solutions that interpolate between the same or different CFTs with arbitrary couplings.

arxiv-2210-12157.title: Error-Covariance Analysis of Monocular Pose Estimation Using Total Least Squares
arxiv-2210-12157.creator: Saeed Maleki, John L. Crassidis, Yang Cheng, Matthias Schmid
arxiv-2210-12157.description: Abstract This study presents a theoretical structure for the monocular pose estimation problem using the total least squares. The unit-vector line-of-sight observations of the features are extracted from the monocular camera images. First, the optimization framework is formulated for the pose estimation problem with observation vectors extracted from unit vectors from the camera center-of-projection, pointing towards the image features.

arxiv-2505-15665.description: Abstract The generalized Langevin equation (GLE) is a useful framework for analyzing and modeling the dynamics of many-body systems in terms of low-dimensional reaction coordinates, with its specific form determined by the choice of projection formalism. We compare parameters derived from different GLE formulations using molecular dynamics simulations of butane’s dihedral angle dynamics.

arxiv-2510-14611.title: An Active Inference Model of Mouse Point-and-Click Behaviour
arxiv-2510-14611.creator: Markus Klar, Sebastian Stein, Fraser Paterson, John H. Williamson, Roderick Murray-Smith
arxiv-2510-14611.description: Abstract We explore the use of Active Inference (AIF) as a computational user model for spatial pointing, a key problem in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI). We present an AIF agent with continuous state, action, and observation spaces, performing one-dimensional mouse pointing and clicking. We use a simple underlying dynamic system to model the mouse cursor dynamics with realistic perceptual delay.

pmc-11742320.description: Glucose-stimulated insulin secretion (GSIS) in pancreatic β-cells is metabolically regulated and progressively diminished during the development of type 2 diabetes (T2D). pmc-12716021.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The synthesized compounds were evaluated for their antidiabetic potential via α‐glucosidase and α‐amylase inhibition assays, as well as for antioxidant activity using 2,2‐diphenyl‐1‐picrylhydrazyl (DPPH), ferric reducing antioxidant power (FRAP), and nitric oxide (NO) scavenging assays.
